neighboring_unit_entries.title: Euler-Maclaurin correction integrals reduce to quadratic sums
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Splits terms according to whether a linear frequency is small, uses local Taylor expansion in the small region and explicit integration in the large region, and controls cancellation by shifting the summation index before binomial expansion.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: Partition by stationary geometry and reduce to Airy-type integrals
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Handles a broad cubic-quadratic double integral by separating small and large quadratic curvature, then partitions y by stationary-point location, deforms contours for decay, and reduces all cases to controlled Airy variants and incomplete Gamma functions.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: Derivative bounds certify short Euler-Maclaurin expansions, nonstationary contours certify decay, saddle-aware integrals reduce to Airy or incomplete-Gamma forms, and remaining terms return to the quadratic-sum interface.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: This synthesis establishes the paper's claimed computational reductions, not numerical practicality or optimized constants.
